messages:
anya: Quick thought — if every model were on the karaoke panel, what emoji would they give as a score? I'll kick it off: gpt-4o -> :sparkles: (overenthusiastic), llama2 -> :microphone: (solid), redwood-65b -> :robot_face: (technical), claude -> :star2: (poetic)
matt: omg biased judge = redwood-65b lol
samira: cue the 'I only take prompts in YAML' dance :dancers:
derek: we need a leaderboard. my vote: alpaca -> :cow: (honest), gpt-3.5 -> :notes: (makes up lyrics)
julie: can someone make a little poll? :please:
ops-bot: Poll created: 'Best model karaoke emoji' — react with an emoji to vote
ramon: adding ground truth: nascent-model -> :crystal_ball: (mysterious), tiny-tiny -> :eyes: (watching very closely)
anya: also, imagine the judge comments: 'This rendition lacked temperature control' :thermometer:
matt: hahahaha
samira: can we get an SVG of 'judge criticising temperature' for the handbook?
derek: I sketched one in doodles, will post (low-effort scribble)
julie: this thread is the culture we deserve :heart:
ops-bot: Reminder: happy hour at 5 — karaoke encouraged :beer: :microphone:
anya: I'll bring lyric sheets for the models (prompt templates included)
matt: i'll bring the backup dataset :floppy_disk:
samira: i'll DJ with ambient prompt templates (no repetition, max diversity)
julie: someone GIF the 'model drops mic' moment and pin it pls
ramon: pinning now :pin: (also adding :sparkles: reaction to gpt-4o)
anya: end of thread — results: too many :sparkles: votes so gpt-4o wins by charisma
matt: congrats gpt-4o :tada:
